verdict.rationale: Factory's Missions let you work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria from a plain-language description before any code is written. Droid also analyzes the codebase and proposes changes for review before applying them, and Linear or Jira issues assigned to Factory are investigated, implemented, and tested. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on how a single plain-language bug or feature request becomes an explicit scoped task artifact outside Missions.
